name: shania
tagline: Serving notice, still serving mutant-level performance
about: The X-Men are a rare breed of employees serving their notice period—still showing up, saving the day, and delivering mutant-level results. Their greatest superpower? Staying professional while mentally preparing for their next adventure! 🧬🚀
funFact: X-Men on notice period don't quit—they're just evolving into their next form!
